name: Uluru & the Outback
about: May–Sep (Southern winter) is cool enough to comfortably walk, Nov–Mar summer heat is extreme (regularly 40°C+).
overview: The sacred red monolith at Australia's dead center, a remote outback pilgrimage built around sunrise and sunset viewing.
costOverview: Everything here is captive-market pricing — there's no nearby town to escape to, so food, tours, and park entry all run above normal Australian rates.
